title: Exported names
hints: A name is exported if it starts with an upper-case letter. `squareArea` is invisible outside the package; `SquareArea` is visible.
Rename `squareArea` → `SquareArea` and `pi` → `Pi`, then add the two missing functions. Parameters of the same type can share it: `func RectangleArea(width, height float64) float64`.
`CircleArea` is `return Pi * square(radius)`. The tests compare with a tiny tolerance (`1e-9`) because floating-point math isn't exact.
